ops.html:
Potentially acutely life-threatening presentation

Note: all left-sided heart failure can also lead to right-sided heart failure (the most common cause of right heart failure is left heart failure).

Causes by group
  • Cardiac — rule out left-sided heart failure (most common)
    • Myocardium: Right Ventricle Infarction; Restrictive Cardiomyopathy
    • Valves: Pulmonary Stenosis; Tricuspid Regurgitation
    • Pericardium: Constrictive Pericarditis; Pericardial Tamponade
  • Pulmonary
    • Parenchyma: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease; Diffuse Lung Disease; Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome; Chronic Lung Infection
    • Vasculature: Pulmonary Embolism; Primary Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension; Pulmonary Veno-Occlusive Disease
